title: Mitosis architecture audit and rebuild exploration

completion_criteria.text: Foundational audit of the current engine complete across all four domains: two-layer fan-out, durability/resume, cost/latency, pipeline rigidity + fragility
External research verdict delivered on whether the architecture is correct, with disconfirming pass and cited prior art
The child_process runtime-capability question settled empirically (does dynamic import of node:child_process EXECUTE inside a Workflow script, not merely resolve)

Three open architecture decisions resolved by the user: adopt an off-the-shelf durable-execution runtime vs only its state model; default speculation depth given that rework costs tokens not machine time; which work-type pipelines to define first
An approved architecture spec for the rebuild exists, superseding or explicitly scoping the six paused repair-oriented mitosis threads

spine.active_goal: M4 HAS TWO COMMITS AND NEITHER IS SHIPPABLE. 777617b (AIMD deletion) on feat/m4-fixed-build-ahead-cap; fc035fc (divergence instrumentation) cut off it. NOTHING PUSHED, NO PR. The ship gate closed 3 FAIL / 1 PASS. Per 0201 all four findings are AUDITED before any implementer runs; the four audits dispatched 2026-08-02T07:07Z had NOT RETURNED at hand-off. Remaining: reconcile the four reports, implement by AMEND to each commit, re-run the gate, ship the two stacked PRs.
spine.next_step: FOUR AUDITS WERE IN FLIGHT AT HAND-OFF AND ARE SESSION-SCOPED -- if they did not return, RE-DISPATCH all four from the spec in the 2026-08-02T07-10 AUDIT DISPATCH entry (read it per 0202, not via MCP). One per finding, read-only: F2 coverage gate (PRIORITY, blocks both commits), F1 foreign-branch filtering, F3 buildAheadCap null (solution-architect), F4 inert window premise. RECONCILE ALL FOUR BEFORE any implementer -- remedies share both commits, so amend-and-rebase is planned ONCE.
open_risks: FOREIGN-BRANCH-FILTERING IS UNASSERTED after 777617b's third e2e deletion. Claimed replacement cites :1148/:1167/:1267 are WRONG; same-url dedup survives at M2b. A restoring test is drafted, red-on-mutant/green-on-engine. UNDER AUDIT F1.

BOTH COMMITS FAIL the required invariant-coverage CI job on the pull_request event: neither adds a file under docs/invariants/coverage/. A BARE run of the check takes the weaker PUSH path and reports green. Remedy is an AMEND to each commit or 777617b lands red. UNDER AUDIT F2.

AMEND-AND-REBASE IS ON THE CRITICAL PATH; no prior entry named it. Amending 777617b changes its SHA, so feat/m4-divergence-instrumentation must be REBASED onto it. The rebase needs its OWN re-verification: full suite per commit, mirror guard, coverage gate per commit on pull_request.

input.buildAheadCap REFUSES null SILENTLY (explicit !== null clause, mitosis.js:3475 at 9ea75d6 -- re-locate by symbol). JSON.stringify maps NaN/Infinity to null, so a computed garbage cap is swallowed. Cap holds 8. Removing BOTH guards CRASHED. UNDER AUDIT F3: one clause or a class?

THE 1839 BASELINE IS ENVIRONMENT-LOCAL, inflated by ~9 tests from a gitignored file in the main worktree. CI and any clean checkout measure 1830. Every 1839/1846 figure in this thread's earlier entries is a main-worktree number, never a CI expectation.

THE TWO KEPT CLAMP TESTS PASS but their `window: 9999` premise is INERT; the engine reads manifest.window nowhere. Tests-only fix at :894/:1247 plus the frontierManifest param. Do NOT restore a persisted-window test. UNDER AUDIT F4 -- if manifest.window IS read, the finding inverts.

FIX-ROUND DISCIPLINE (standing memory; five prior rounds each introduced a new defect on an unnamed path): plan against INVARIANTS, never against this finding list. A drafted mutation-proven fix answers 'does this edit work', never 'is this the right surface'.

PR scope is FROZEN at creation; title/body edits denied, later facts go in a comment (0142). pr-create is the ONLY PR path, requires --provenance with --origin machine, rejects angle brackets in --what, caps free text at 200 chars. MERGE STAYS HUMAN-GATED for both PRs.

STACK SHAPE IS FIXED (decision A): PR 1 = feat/m4-fixed-build-ahead-cap -> main with 777617b alone; PR 2 = feat/m4-divergence-instrumentation -> that branch, with fc035fc alone. Independent PRs off main are REJECTED: commit 2's site sits inside the block commit 1 rewrites.

CI ORDERING RULE: read CI on both head SHAs BEFORE opening either PR. Bodies are frozen at creation, so opening first would permanently lock in a not-run verification line on this thread's longest-standing risk.

TWO LEDGER STORES DISAGREE: session-continuity-inline is LIVE, the other STALE. Spine and ALL WRITES go through MCP, but there is NO MCP READER for session entries or decisions -- read those with `git show _ledger:<path>` per 0202. 0199 is a VOID probe artifact, never link it.

STILL NOT M4'S, all measured and left deliberately: the dead reviewDecision payload at mitosis.js:1667/1671 and :3800; advance.toRestack/toOpen dead weight; .mitosis/ not gitignored plus two log lines claiming it is; the M3 termination residual.

Five pre-existing dirty paths stay untouched. Stage explicit paths only, NEVER git add -A. Mutants via MITOSIS_PATH scratch copies only, never by patching a committed artifact. FOUR DIRTY WORKTREES REMAIN BY DESIGN (0195); lens worktrees were reaped.
out_of_scope: Any change at mitosis.js:4058-4061. H-C is REFUTED by 0159, not deferred - the done-union is correct and narrowing it is a liveness regression. Re-opening needs new evidence of an unconfirmed-ship producer.
Removing or weakening the veto at mitosis.js:3787. It is the resurrection guard (0160); frontier-train-e2e.test.mjs:578 forbids it. M2 names and logs it, nothing more.
Un-ignoring docs/superpowers/plans/ wholesale, and git add -f as the tracking mechanism - both rejected by 0158 in favour of the /* plus negation form.
Track A / continuity-ledger-plugin until all mitosis MSPs are delivered (0136). A-1, A-2, A-3 and the Track A half of Wave 0 are DEFERRED, not abandoned.
Any further B-6 work. Implemented, merged and green; the invariant is discharged. Re-opening needs a new reason, not a re-read.
Rewriting the specs' 78 anchors as a standalone effort - rejected by 0148. Re-baseline by execution per MSP instead.
Executing run-readiness-repair's MSP-0..MSP-10. Quiescent-advance M0..M8 lands first, and the overlap (M0/M1 against MSP-6/MSP-7) must be reconciled before that spec is scheduled.
Pipelines for refactor, perf, docs or chore - closed by 0118. Limits PIPELINES only, not the PR title type vocabulary.
The feat pipeline - 0110 sequences it second, after the fix pipeline proves the effector boundary.
Speculation depth above 1 - 0109 requires a restack proven for the fix work type first.
Bootstrapping a target repo's test infrastructure as a side effect of shipping - closed by 0117; that is verify-setup, human-invoked.
Adopting an off-the-shelf durable-execution runtime - closed by 0108. A webhook, server or daemon for the relaunch trigger - closed by 0119.
fileScope-only task-edge derivation - rejected by 0116, settled by 0120.
Cluster-aware scheduling and the journal's 2000-char model-output paging - fenced out by spec section 1.
Dispatching or restarting any target-repo mitosis run.
Opening a pull request for docs/mitosis-core-rebuild-spec - the user ruled on 2026-07-30 that leaving it without a PR is fine.
SUPERSEDED 2026-08-02 by 0195: the leaked-worktree fence is lifted and DONE - 9 of 13 reaped, 4 dirty ones deliberately held. Still out of scope: the Step 0 reaper and the two parked stashes.
Re-opening M5. It is merged as 9ea75d6; the declared M3 termination residual (suite exit code not recovered) belongs to a later MSP, not to a re-run of M5.
